scope: Eight paper screenshot groups; a subset of existing research runs.
environment_note: Input-reader dependencies openpyxl 3.1.5 and xlrd 2.0.2 were installed in a separate validation directory. The original experiment environment was not modified.
corrected_operational_issues: Runtime doctor now ignores numeric port/readiness bindings when checking font paths.
Threshold closure metadata counts the selected 15 outputs rather than retaining a historical 90-output label.
Fixed-input export includes all registered source.zip members; preparation rejects missing frozen members before model startup.
A dedicated six-case reuse batch closes all learning and shuts down owned model services before any query execution or once-only scoring.
Owned reuse service routing name matches the unchanged archived model request transport.
remaining_reproduction_dependencies: Fresh threshold execution requires newly learned main A skills.
Historical cost numbers are recorded request-time measurements, not guaranteed fresh hardware timing.

archive.public_release_policy: Clean publication snapshot; full earlier research history preserved in author private archive.

official_source_reconstruction.route: Official UCI ZIPs plus archived pure curator functions and published seed/condition/hash metadata.
